We Handle The Complexity

RTM Travel (Remmitz Travel Management) is an ASATA and IATA-accredited corporate travel management company (TMC) serving South African businesses since 2008. Operating in association with eTravel, we manage corporate flights, accommodation, car hire, and event logistics. Businesses partnering with a TMC typically reduce annual travel expenditure by 15% to 20% through automated policy enforcement and negotiated supplier rates, while meeting statutory duty of care obligations (as of July 2026).

Transparent Transaction Pricing

Corporate travel management services by RTM Travel operate on a transparent transaction-fee model. Unlike retail travel agents who mark up bookings, we charge a flat fee per flight ticket, hotel stay, or car hire reservation (ranging from R80 to R250 as of July 2026). This ensures all commissions and corporate discounts negotiated with airlines (such as SAA and Airlink) and hotel groups (such as Southern Sun and City Lodge) are passed directly to our clients, ensuring full spend visibility.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about working with RTM Travel.

What is a Travel Management Company (TMC)?

A Travel Management Company manages all aspects of business travel on behalf of a company. Unlike a standard travel agent, a TMC integrates with your corporate travel policy, provides detailed spend reporting, manages duty of care obligations, and offers 24/7 support for active travellers.

How does RTM Travel differ from booking online?

Online platforms offer no policy enforcement, no consolidated reporting, no duty of care coverage, and no live support when disruptions occur. RTM Travel acts as an extension of your finance and operations teams — negotiating corporate rates, enforcing your travel policy, and providing 24/7 support when your employees are in transit.

Is RTM Travel ASATA and IATA accredited?

Yes. RTM Travel is fully accredited by ASATA (Association of Southern African Travel Agents) and IATA (International Air Transport Association), and operates in association with eTravel. This ensures the highest standards of financial security and professional conduct.

Does RTM Travel provide 24/7 support?

Yes. We provide 24/7 support for all active bookings. Whether a flight is cancelled, a traveller is stranded, or an emergency arises, our team is available around the clock to reroute, rebook, and resolve the situation.

What types of businesses does RTM Travel work with?

RTM Travel works with South African businesses of all sizes — from growing SMEs with regular domestic travel to large corporates managing complex international programmes. Our service scales to your travel volume and complexity.

Ready to simplify corporate travel?

Tell us what your team needs. Our Cape Town desk responds to new B2B enquiries in under 5 minutes during business hours, with 24/7 emergency support for active bookings (as of July 2026).

Support: 24/7 travel assistance for active bookings

Focus: Corporate flights, accommodation, car hire, and approvals
